name: tcga-mobile
description: Mobile-friendly UI tweaks for TCG Arena (tcg-arena.fr) as a Safari (iOS) and Firefox (Android) extension.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --url https://www.tcg-arena.fr/play
scripts.run:android: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --target firefox-android --firefox-apk org.mozilla.firefox --adb-device "$ADB_DEVICE"
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.safari:convert: npm run build:safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location safari --app-name "TCGA Mobile" --bundle-identifier com.jossjacobo.tcgamobile --ios-only --no-open --force
